jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own and proactively manage a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, building trusted, long-term business relationships. Define customer success outcomes collaboratively and develop strategies to help customers achieve their operational and commercial objectives. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, coordinating questions, requests, and escalations across relevant internal teams. Drive customer retention and net dollar retention by identifying expansion opportunities and implementing proactive churn-reduction strategies. Use a consultative approach to increase product adoption, engagement, customer loyalty, and package growth. Analyse customer data and usage patterns to identify opportunities to improve utilisation, engagement, and business performance. Identify and develop upsell opportunities for additional products and services based on customer needs and business objectives. Manage strategic customer escalations and help resolve complex issues related to the effective use of the platform. Review customer feedback, complaints, and concerns, identifying opportunities to improve the overall customer experience. Maintain a strong understanding of products, services, and system updates in order to provide relevant recommendations and guidance. Gather customer feedback, requirements, and insights to inform future product improvements and releases. Partner with Sales, Support, Product, Marketing, Design, and other teams to communicate customer needs, opportunities, and risks effectively. Act as a strategic advisor by applying hospitality industry knowledge to recommend ways customers can optimise technology and improve their business outcomes. Stay current on hospitality industry trends, commercial strategies, and best practices to provide relevant and forward-looking guidance. Requirements: Proven experience in account management, customer success, relationship management, or a comparable customer-facing role. 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing hospitality environment, such as hotel operations, front office, hotel sales, revenue management, hospitality technology, or a related field, is highly desirable. Experience using a property management system (PMS) or hospitality technology platform, either as an end user or from the technology/vendor side. Experience managing accounts across European hospitality markets is a significant advantage. Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish trust and maintain strong business partnerships. Demonstrated ability to communicate, present, negotiate, and influence effectively with stakeholders at different organisational levels. Strong consultative selling and commercial skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and translate them into expansion opportunities. Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using customer data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and engagement improvements. Excellent listening, presentation, organisation, and project management skills. Ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and projects independently while maintaining a high level of attention to detail. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to understand customer concerns, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate effective resolutions. Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working autonomously in a remote, results-driven, and fast-growth environment. Adaptable, reliable, and mature, with a genuine passion for building long-term customer relationships. Comfortable working across multiple European markets and communicating primarily in English. Professional-level French fluency, with the ability to confidently lead customer meetings and business conversations in French, is desirable. Benefits: Remote-first and remote-always working environment. Flexible working arrangements suited to a distributed international team. Paid time off in accordance with local labour requirements. Monthly Wellness Fridays, providing an extra-long weekend each month. Fully paid parental leave. Home office stipend based on country of residence. Access to professional development courses through an internal learning platform. Opportunities for management training, upskilling, knowledge sharing, and professional development. Opportunity to work with customers across international hospitality markets. High degree of autonomy and ownership within a fast-growing, globally distributed environment. Opportunity to contribute to the transformation of hospitality through modern technology and AI-enabled solutions. jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist (M/F/D)
jobs.description: Accountabilities Own and maintain process maps, SOPs, and ownership records across the full revenue lifecycle, ensuring processes are followed in practice, identifying gaps, and escalating persistent issues. Lead assigned process and operational improvements from discovery through implementation, documentation, and follow-up, keeping actions, owners, dependencies, and risks visible through completion. Translate business needs into clear Salesforce requirements and collaborate with Salesforce administrators and external consultants on solution design, implementation, and testing. Facilitate cross-functional workshops to identify process breakdowns, uncover root causes, agree on solutions, and support adoption and change management. Partner with Enablement and relevant stakeholders to reinforce new processes and ensure improvements are consistently adopted. Analyse recurring tickets, exception reports, user feedback, and operational issues to distinguish isolated errors from systemic problems and coordinate sustainable resolutions. Monitor data quality and Salesforce hygiene across the revenue lifecycle, addressing the underlying process issues that cause incomplete, inaccurate, or inconsistent data. Analyse process, Salesforce, ticket, and customer-buying data to develop evidence-based recommendations and measure the effectiveness of implemented improvements. Assess the usage and effectiveness of go-to-market tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Chili Piper, recommending improvements and tracking their impact on revenue performance. Build strong relationships across functions and proactively drive accountability, corrective actions, and continuous improvement in a distributed working environment. Requirements Substantial professional experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, or a related B2B SaaS function, ideally with experience supporting complex buying processes and multi-stakeholder deals. Experience documenting, auditing, and improving commercial processes, with a proven ability to identify root causes and drive issues through to resolution. Strong stakeholder management and change management skills, including confidence facilitating workshops, influencing cross-functional teams, and holding process owners accountable. Analytical mindset with hands-on experience working with data using Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or comparable analytics and no-code tools. Genuine curiosity about customer buying behaviour, market dynamics, and how revenue processes operate in practice. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including its core data model, opportunity management, reporting, and common automation concepts; able to investigate issues, define requirements, and test solutions without being primarily responsible for Salesforce administration. Practical understanding of lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, and mid-to-downstream revenue processes, including opportunity stages, forecasting, quoting, CPQ, renewals, amendments, and expansion. Strong problem-solving, communication, organisation, and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Comfortable working fully remotely within a multicultural, globally distributed team. Experience in cybersecurity is not required; experience in a technology-driven SaaS environment is advantageous. Benefits Fully remote position within the EMEA region, with the opportunity to work from Romania. Opportunity to contribute directly to revenue growth and operational efficiency within a growing international SaaS business. Exposure to the full revenue lifecycle and collaboration with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and other global functions. Opportunity to work at the forefront of cybersecurity and contribute to solutions addressing sophisticated and evolving digital threats. International and cross-functional working environment with colleagues across different markets and disciplines. Strong focus on innovation, transparency, teamwork, and customer-centricity.
